explanation: Two vertically stacked circles (heavy 19.3 kg on top, light 1 kg below launched upward at 24 m/s) collide. With tiny dt=0.00059 and gravity, positional correction / impulse is applied over many micro-steps while bodies remain in contact (gap ~0.001 at step 98, ~0.006 at 99), injecting energy each substep.
